Customer communication - AI tools for contractors

Answering enquiries, following up on quotes, sending updates and handling calls you miss.

Why this matters Missed calls are missed jobs — most customers call the next company on the list.

What Customer communication actually involves

Most trade businesses lose work before they know it existed: the phone rings while you are on a job and the caller moves down the list. The tools here cover missed calls, follow-up on quotes you have already sent, and the progress updates customers expect once work starts.

Frequently asked questions

Which customer communication tools are worth trying first?

The three that stand out here are Housecall Pro (Home service businesses that want one app covering booking through to payment), Jobber (Owner-operators and small crews moving off paper and spreadsheets), ServiceTitan (Established businesses with multiple crews and a dedicated office team). Start with the one that matches your size and the work you do most, not the one with the longest feature list.

How much does customer communication software cost?

Across the 14 tools on this page, 7 have a free tier and the rest are paid, most of them billed per user per month. Prices move often, so confirm on the vendor site before committing.

Can I try these tools for free?

Yes 鈥?Workiz, Tidio, ChatGPT, Claude all have a free tier, so you can run a few real jobs through them before paying anything.

What is the cheapest way to stop missing calls?

A call answering service or an AI receptionist, which costs far less than one lost job a month. If you work alone and cannot pick up while working, that is usually the highest return piece of software you can buy.
